registration_timing: after attempt-1 exposed all tied R16/R32 trajectories and one incomplete R64 seed-101 initialization measurement, before any completed R64 trajectory or untied interval-gradient trajectory
status_label: post-partial registered recovery; not as-preregistered completion of loop_schedule_kappa_surface_v1
claim_scope: post-partial mechanism mapping of a reduced tied kappa surface and matched optimization stress in the frozen small-scale two-linear residual-loop family

observed_before_recovery.disclosure: The R16/R32 trajectories and the incomplete R64 seed-101 E0 value were inspected while diagnosing the orchestration failure. They are prior evidence for this recovery, not untouched outcomes.

r64_tied.note: all three cells are rerun from initialization; the incomplete attempt-1 R64 event is not reused

untied_gradients.note: intermediate untied kappa probes are omitted to preserve the registered aggregate budget; sealed terminal untied kappa supplies only the point-equivalence control

comparison.winner_rule: best model must beat the runner-up by at least 4 AICc units and have no more than 0.9 times the runner-up blocked-CV RMSE; otherwise unresolved

depth_curvature.onset_rule: first candidate where point C(E)<=-0.2 and the 95% paired-seed-bootstrap upper bound is below -0.1
depth_curvature.terminal_role: E4096 is excluded from first-onset confirmation because its direction was known before both registrations

gradient_coupling.stress_ratio: geometric-mean tied interval maximum gradient divided by the matched untied geometric mean
gradient_coupling.co_localization_rule: at the curvature-onset interval, the R64 stress ratio is at least 5 and exceeds the corresponding R16 and R32 ratios
gradient_coupling.association_diagnostic: omitted in recovery because R64 E512 kappa is not measured

integrity_controls.tied_terminal_replication: all nine tied R16/R32/R64 terminal per-seed kappas must match their sealed predecessors within absolute log ratio 0.02
integrity_controls.untied_terminal_point_equivalence: the sealed six-depth terminal untied point gamma must satisfy abs(gamma)<=0.1
integrity_controls.limitation: the original requirement for untied equivalence at four of five trajectory checkpoints is unobserved and cannot be claimed

classification.post_partial_depth_training_transition: r64_change_point wins, preterminal curvature onset exists, gradient co-localization passes, tied terminal replication passes, and sealed untied terminal point equivalence passes
classification.post_partial_geometric_transition_withou: r64_change_point wins and onset exists but gradient co-localization fails
classification.post_partial_smooth_surface: separable or smooth_interaction wins and no onset exists
classification.integrity_failure: partial-ledger admission, tied replication, or untied terminal equivalence fails
classification.form_unresolved: none of the registered branches is licensed

resource_accounting.attempt_1_debit_basis: outer command host reported 1204.1 seconds before termination

claim_boundary: This labeled post-partial recovery cannot be described as the original experiment completing as preregistered. It can report only whether the reduced tied surface and matched gradient controls support a depth-by-training transition in this one small residual-loop construction; it cannot establish gradient causality, general Transformer behavior, or task performance.

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
